original.statement: The frontend.cache-split-interval CLI flag is removed; results caching interval is now determined by querier.split-queries-by-interval.

decision.reason: [ev-f5a61f629314] states "`frontend.cache-split-interval` CLI flag is removed", so the subject is the cli-flag --frontend.cache-split-interval and the change type is removed. The same line says results caching interval "is now determined by `querier.split-queries-by-interval`", which supports a replacedBy of the flag-style name --querier.split-queries-by-interval. All validator checks were inconclusive (render failed), so this rests on the prose alone.
